# AIR CHECK - wiring list and pin map (v1.3, no custom PCB)

## Power tree

```
6 x AA (BT1) --F1 PTC 0.5 A--> VPACK_F 5.4..10.8 V
   VPACK_F --> PS1 Pololu S9V11E2A (buck-boost) --> +4V0
   VPACK_F --R1 1M--+--R2 220k-- GND        PACK_ADC on GPIO3 (C1 100 nF)
+4V0 --> D1 LM66200 (ideal diode, blocks reverse) --> VSYS --> FireBeetle BAT (J1)
VSYS --> Sunrise VBB, LED common anode (spliced onto the J1 + lead)
USB-C --> FireBeetle CN3165 --> VSYS at 4.2 V: D1 blocks, the cells are never charged;
          the Sunrise and the LED then run from USB too
VSYS --> FireBeetle TPS62A02 --> +3V3 (always on): ESP32-C6, SGP40, SHT40
+3V3 --[SW1 Pololu #2810, ON = GPIO2]--> +3V3_SEN --> SEN62, R3/R4 pull-ups
GPIO18 --> CO2_VDDIO --> Sunrise VDDIO, R5/R6 pull-ups  (EN = GPIO14, R7 pull-down)
```

## Rails

| rail | min | nom | max | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| VPACK | 5.40 V | 8.70 V | 10.80 V | 6 x AA in series: 0.9 V/cell floor, 1.45 V L91 average, 1.8 V open-circuit of a fresh L91 |
| VPACK_F | 5.40 V | 8.70 V | 10.80 V | VPACK behind the PTC fuse F1 |
| +4V0 | 3.92 V | 4.00 V | 4.08 V | Pololu S9V11E2A, trimpot set to 4.00 V +-2 %; always on |
| VSYS | 3.88 V | 4.00 V | 4.24 V | FireBeetle battery input: +4V0 through the LM66200, or the FireBeetle's own CN3165 at 4.2 V +-1 % while USB is plugged in |
| +3V3 | 3.20 V | 3.30 V | 3.40 V | FireBeetle TPS62A02 buck, always on |
| +3V3_SEN | 3.20 V | 3.30 V | 3.40 V | +3V3 behind the Pololu #2810 switch |
| CO2_VDDIO | 0.00 V | 3.30 V | 3.40 V | GPIO18 driven high only while the Sunrise is enabled |
| GND | 0.00 V | 0.00 V | 0.00 V | system ground |

## GPIO map (ESP32-C6 on the DFRobot FireBeetle 2)

| GPIO | header label | signal | dir | LP pad | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | (on board) | REG_ADC | analog in | yes | FireBeetle 1M/1M divider from VSYS: 4.0 V on the pack, 4.2 V on USB |
| 1 | 1 | BTN | in | yes | wake source, internal pull-up, active low |
| 2 | 2 | SEN_EN | out | yes | held LOW in sleep |
| 3 | 3 | PACK_ADC | analog in | yes | pack / 5.545, ADC1 channel 3 |
| 6 | 6 | SENS_SDA | bidir | yes | LP_I2C SDA - a fixed pad on the C6, not remappable |
| 7 | 7 | SENS_SCL | bidir | yes | LP_I2C SCL - a fixed pad on the C6, not remappable |
| 14 | 14 | CO2_EN | out | no | R7 keeps it low through reset and sleep |
| 16 | 16 | LED_R | out | no | U0TXD: the ROM boot log only makes the red LED flicker |
| 17 | 17 | CO2_SDA | bidir | no | input while the Sunrise is off |
| 18 | 18 | CO2_VDDIO | out | no | Sunrise VDDIO and its pull-ups; low whenever EN is low |
| 19 | SDA | SEN_SDA | bidir | no | input while the SEN62 is off |
| 20 | SCL | SEN_SCL | bidir | no | input while the SEN62 is off |
| 21 | 21 | CO2_SCL | bidir | no | input while the Sunrise is off |
| 22 | 22 | LED_G | out | no | sink, active low |
| 23 | 23 | LED_B | out | no | sink, active low |

Reserved / not used:

| GPIO | reason |
|---|---|
| 4 | strapping pin (MTMS) - left unconnected |
| 5 | strapping pin (MTDI) - left unconnected |
| 8 | strapping pin - left unconnected |
| 9 | strapping pin, BOOT button on the FireBeetle |
| 12 | native USB D- |
| 13 | native USB D+ |
| 15 | strapping pin, FireBeetle green LED - driven low by the firmware |

## I2C buses (100 kHz)

| bus | pins | address | device | pull-ups |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| LP | SENS_SDA / SENS_SCL | 0x59 | U2 SparkFun Qwiic SGP40 | on the boards: SparkFun 4.7k (I2C jumper closed), Grove board's own |
| LP | SENS_SDA / SENS_SCL | 0x44 | U3 Seeed Grove SHT40 | on the boards: SparkFun 4.7k (I2C jumper closed), Grove board's own |
| SEN | SEN_SDA / SEN_SCL | 0x6B | U1 SEN62 (PM1/2.5/4/10) | R3, R4 |
| CO2 | CO2_SDA / CO2_SCL | 0x68 | U4 Senseair Sunrise CO2 | R5, R6 |

The SEN62 and the Sunrise share the ESP32-C6's single HP I2C controller; the firmware routes it to one pin pair at a time and leaves the other pair as inputs, so nothing drives a sensor that is switched off.

## Inline parts: where they are soldered

|---|---|---|

| R2 | 220 k, 1 %, 0.25 W, metal film, THT | at FireBeetle IO3 to GND, together with C1 |

| R5 | 10 k, 1 %, 0.25 W, metal film, THT | across Sunrise pins 3 (VDDIO) and 4 (SDA) |
| R6 | 10 k, 1 %, 0.25 W, metal film, THT | across Sunrise pins 3 (VDDIO) and 5 (SCL) |
| R7 | 100 k, 1 %, 0.25 W, metal film, THT | at FireBeetle IO14 to GND |
| R8 | 1 k, 1 %, 0.25 W, metal film, THT | on the LED's red lead |
